project.title: Crochet Project: Baby Wearables
project.description: My sister is about to give birth soon, so I thought of making socks for her baby. As for my progress, so far, I've only done one sock and will do the other pair very soon!

project.title: PAWssion Project
project.description: This is a very small project/advocacy that I have, everytime I see strays (mostly kittens), I try to foster them and rehome them after some time. My cats also used to be strays, most of them I just found outside of our house.

project.title: Angel of My Dreams
project.description: Recently, I've been taking a lot of pictures of my cat and posting them on my secret instagram account. Nobody knows except me that I own that account. It's like a place for me where I can post pictures of my cat that I took, my very own collection of her images.
